description: The Grove LA is an open-air environment pulsing with style & energy that offers some of Los Angeles' best boutiques, shops, restaurants, & entertainment. This outdoor shopping center features a unique trolley system, dancing fountains, and a mix of upscale retailers and dining options, making it a popular destination for both locals and tourists.
name: The Grove
